cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/tests/run_big2.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys, time, random, collections
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from protocol import loads, validate
from te.session import run_case
import gen as G
import verify as V

seed0 = int(sys.argv[1]); N = int(sys.argv[2])
bad = 0
for it in range(N):
    rng = random.Random(seed0 + it)
    req = G.gen_request(rng, big=True)
    try:
        validate(req)
    except Exception as e:
        print("GENERATOR invalid", seed0 + it, e); bad += 1; continue
    t1 = time.time()
    resp = {"cases": [run_case(c) for c in req["cases"]]}
    dt = time.time() - t1
    print("  case %d solve %.2fs" % (it, dt), flush=True)
    errs = V.verify(req, resp)
    if errs:
        bad += 1
        print("=== seed", seed0 + it, "errors:", [e["errors"][:6] for e in errs[:2]])
        json.dump(req, open('/tmp/bad_big_%d.json' % (seed0 + it), 'w'))
print("done", N, "bad", bad)
PYEOF
